situation: markdown: Olivia is the Operations Manager for a growing fresh-produce delivery service. Her role involves optimizing delivery routes, managing delivery schedules, and improving operational efficiency. She is evaluated based on on-time delivery rates, customer satisfaction, and overall delivery cost savings. Olivia can implement changes by altering delivery schedules, redesigning routes, and adjusting staffing based on data-driven insights.

persona.context: Olivia manages a fleet of delivery vehicles and drivers to ensure timely delivery of fresh produce to customers. The service uses electric delivery vans to align with sustainability goals.
constraints: Must optimize for minimal mileage to save on fuel costs
Must maintain freshness of produce upon delivery
